accepted_claim: In these five stable observations across two specifically identified Gallery process generations, the executable and 381 mapped ELF files were bound to that process and hashed; the observed executable, ART, Android runtime and nativebridge/lazy bridge file identities are established for this exact signed APK and Main epoch.
not_granted: Business qualification beyond existing separate reviews
Proof that nativebridge actually translated ARM code in these samples
An active ARM backend protocol/version identity not observed here
Immutable or universally root-owned system-code assertion
source_review_findings: Sampler binds PID birth, pidfd liveness, four UIDs through held Main uid_map, process name, PID namespace and actual /proc/PID/exe; identity is checked again after collection.

Each mapped file is opened beneath the held target process root and checked against maps device major/minor and inode, then hashed with stable stat; complete maps bytes and process root identity are checked before/after.
The cache uses full observed stat identity including ctime/mtime/size/device/inode, so this is observed file identity, not immutable filesystem attestation.

Both unresolved path candidates are exactly r--s property/idmap mappings selected by the broad ENGINE_NAME regex; the one non-ELF overlay candidate is also r--s. They do not establish an unidentified executable mapping.
The exporter retains the four non-path executable mappings: two named Dalvik JIT caches, vDSO and vsyscall. None is silently converted into a hashed file.
The stable set excludes the actual first round launch with maps_before_after_equal=false.
Existing independent signature audit binds the same7385781-byte APK SHA347c376f and UID10064/version40030; no new signature claim is inferred from filenames.
